title: Ukrainian Puff Pastry Tagine
description: A savory twist on traditional French puff pastry tart, featuring a Ukrainian-inspired filling. Perfect for a light dinner or snack.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Roll out puff pastry to a thickness of 1/8 inch (3 mm). Cut into a rectangle, about 12 inches x 8 inches (30 cm x 20 cm).
In a large skillet, cook the Ukrainian sausage over medium-high heat until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced lamb's liver to the skillet and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Stir in the chopped onion and minced garlic. Cook until the onion is translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Sprinkle the shredded Morbier cheese over the top of the pastry, leaving a 1-inch (2.5 cm) border around the edges.
Add the cooked sausage and liver mixture on top of the cheese, spreading it evenly.
Fold the edges of the pastry up over the filling, pressing gently to seal.
Use a sharp knife to cut a few slits in the top crust to allow steam to escape.
Brush the top crust with a little water and sprinkle with tagine spice mix.
Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown and puffed.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 5-10 minutes before serving.
